18.t: Working with data: cooling with different lids
q: Calculate the temperature drop for the cup with no lid.
Explain why adding a lid makes a big difference.
A lid stops hot water vapour escaping (evaporation) and stops warm air rising away (convection).
Explain which transfer the foam jacket reduces most, and why.
Conduction through the cup’s side: foam traps air, a very poor conductor. It also cuts convection next to the cup.
